    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    guide = None
    for r in range(h):
        v = grid[r][0]
        if v != bg and all(x == v for x in grid[r]):
            guide = ('row', r, v)
            break
    if guide is None:
        for c in range(w):
            v = grid[0][c]
            if v != bg and all(grid[r][c] == v for r in range(h)):
                guide = ('col', c, v)
                break
    if guide is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    axis, pos, marker = guide
    pts = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != marker]
    if not pts:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if axis == 'row':
        lo = min(r for r, c, v in pts)
        hi = max(r for r, c, v in pts)
        shift = pos + 1 - lo
        moved = [(r + shift, c, v) for r, c, v in pts]
        stripe = max(r for r, c, v in moved) + 1
        for r, c, v in pts: out[r][c] = bg
        for r, c, v in moved: out[r][c] = v
        if 0 <= stripe < h: out[stripe] = [8] * w
    else:
        lo = min(c for r, c, v in pts)
        shift = pos + 1 - lo

        for r, c, v in moved: out[r][c] = v
        if 0 <= stripe < w:
